svg.text: Where the logo lives on the three basic formats
A4 document: horizontal lockup top-left, 20 mm margins
16:9 slide / cover: primary wordmark bottom-left or centred over the lamp
Square: symbol tile or vertical stack centred

Placement: top-left for reading surfaces, bottom-left or centred for covers and screens. The logo never shares its edge with another logo; partner marks sit on the opposite side separated by a hairline and 2x clear space.
